title: Selective Sentinella Lymph Node Biopsy with Indocyanine Green in Patients with Breast Cancer
official: INDOCYANINE GREEN for SELECTIVE SENTINELLA AXILLARY LYMPH NODE BIOPSY in PATIENTS with BREAST CANCER
summary: The current observational study aims to perform the sentinel lymph node in breast cancer in the usual way with technetium 99 and add a second tracer, indocyanine green. The objective is to evaluate the detection rate of the lymph node with indocyanine green compared to the usual technique.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients \>18 years of age with breast cancer who are candidates for sentinel lymph node detection will be included.
* N0 patients or patients who have undergone target axillary detection with good response

Exclusion Criteria:

* Lymphadenectomy
